basic_info.description: 607-619 Oak Street presents a rare and compelling investment opportunity in San Francisco. This well-located, multi-unit property consists of six units, five of which will be delivered vacant, providing an ideal scenario for a Tenancy-in-Common (TIC) development or owner-occupant flexibility. Situated in the desirable Hayes Valley neighborhood, this asset offers investors the chance to capitalize on a prime location with strong appreciation potential.  Offer date is April 23rd, 2025. Court confirmation will be required.
